newsitem.title: USA: Eastern Co urges holders to reject proxy.
newsitem.headline: Eastern Co urges holders to reject proxy.

text.p: The board of directors of The Eastern Co said Wednesday it was urging its shareholders to reject a proposal made by Millbrook Capital Management Inc to elect three candidates to the board.

Millbrook had its MML Investments LLC affiliate begin soliciting proxies from shareholders in its efforts to elect a slate of three directors at the next annual shareholders meeting. If elected, the slate would propose measures to increase shareholder value, said Millbrook, which owns 6.61 percent of the company.
But the board said the proxy was "harmful" to the company and its shareholders.
"We are urging all our shareholders to reject your campaign by signing and returning a WHITE proxy card with a vote in favor of management," it said.
"We have worked hard to build a strong financial base from which to create long-term value for our shareholders.
"We believe that you are trying to use that strength...to support your highly leveraged offer and thereby deprive the shareholders of the value that strength will produce."
In December, Millbrook was prevented from holding a special shareholders meeting in order to propose the purchase of the company.
